subject: Hosted API retainer pathway — pilot minimums and credit handling
messages:
From: Maria Chen <maria@brightledger.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: hosted API retainer options for pilot

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the latency and token economics looked promising. We are evaluating a 3-month pilot to validate LLM features across two product surfaces (search ranking + support summarization). Before we schedule procurement, Can you confirm: 

- Do you offer a small monthly retainer (vs. large committed seat) for Hosted API that includes some up-front credits?
- If so, what are the minimums and the overage calculation (per-token or monthly smoothing)?
- Are there starter discounts for pilots under $10k/mo, and how are credits applied to overages?

Attached a high-level expected usage sample (brightledger_usage_sample.csv). We're also sensitive to early-stage price protections in case we scale quickly.

Appreciate a short summary we can share with procurement.

Best,
Maria Chen
Head of ML, BrightLedger
(attachment: brightledger_usage_sample.csv - CSV)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Chen <maria@brightledger.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: hosted API retainer options for pilot

Hi Maria — great to hear and thanks for the sample usage file. Quick summary below; attaching our standard Q2 rate card for reference. (attachment: redwood_rate_card_q2.pdf)

Options we typically offer for pilots (hosted API, no Dedicated):

1) Starter Retainer (Pilot) — $5k/month
   - Includes $5k in credits applied first-months; overages billed per-token at published rates after credits.
   - Smoothing: we can amortize the $5k credit over three months on the invoice if you prefer predictable monthly accounting.

2) Trial Credits + Pay-as-you-go — No monthly minimum, but no committed discount; good for very light POCs.

3) Minimum Baseline (discounted) — $15k/month commit with 10% volume discount and priority support SLA.

A few clarifications we usually surface:
- Credits apply to invoice line items before any volume discounts.
- Overage rates are per-token; if you expect bursts, we can enable soft-burst protection (alerts + temporary throttle) to avoid surprise bills.
- We can create a short-term rate protection clause (90 days) for pilots that convert to a baseline commitment.

If you'd like, I can loop in Monica (cc'd) to propose a one-page commercial and a draft SOW for a $5k starter retainer. Does that sound like the right path?

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_rate_card_q2.pdf - PDF)
From: Maria Chen <maria@brightledger.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightledger.com
Date: 2026-07-05T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: hosted API retainer options for pilot

Thanks Jasmine — helpful. A few follow-ups from procurement and engineering: 

- We like the $5k starter retainer if credits can be amortized (accounting prefers monthly smoothing).
- Can you confirm whether the $5k credit is refundable if we cancel mid-month? (Procurement prefers non-refundable credits but clear pro-rated handling.)
- For overage: can you provide an example calc for our expected profile (attached CSV) showing monthly bill at 50k vs 250k tokens/day?

Assuming the $5k starter retainer works and the overage math is sane, procurement will greenlight a short SOW + PO. Please include cancellation terms and a 90-day rate protection clause in the draft.

Best,
Maria Chen
Head of ML, BrightLedger
(attachment referenced: brightledger_usage_sample.csv)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Chen <maria@brightledger.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: hosted API retainer options for pilot

Hi Maria — looping in Monica (commercial lead) and Aditya (pricing/finance) to confirm custom starter terms. Quick answers while they review: 

- Refundability: standard starter credits are non-refundable but can be pro-rated on cancellation; we will document pro-rata treatment in the SOW.
- Amortization: we can invoice the $5k as $1.67k/month over three months for your accounting if that helps.
- Overage example: based on the attached CSV, 50k tokens/day ~ 1.5M tokens/month -> estimated monthly before credits: $1,800; 250k tokens/day ~ 7.5M/month -> $8,600. Exact numbers depend on model mix (embedding vs. chat tokens) — Monica can mock a model-mix calc.

Monica / Aditya — can you: 
1) Prepare a one-page commercial (SOW + PO language) for a $5k starter retainer with 3mo amortization and a 90-day rate-protection clause.
2) Confirm the overage calcs applied to BrightLedger's sample.
3) Recommend default model mix assumptions we should use for the quote.

Maria — we'll aim to get the one-pager and a sample invoice by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
